items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: Ken Murray was in that, and Harriet Hilliard... But they played the leads.

ctx.x: You wrote both the music and the lyrics, huh?

Yeah, and it was a pretty horrible song, but it -- I don't even remember it, the melody or anything about it, but that was the picture, Ken Murray was in that, and Harriet Hilliard, that's Harriet Nelson now. Well, she was then. But they played the leads. I'll tell you something funny about that picture. We did it and we were leaving for New York, and I said, "We've got to get the money." We were leaving like that night, and at that time the withholding had just come in, as far as bands were concerned, and they…
That's the thing about a musician, he can always improvise on his feet, right?
